In this role, you will identify business opportunities, turn innovative ideas into practical solutions and enable our teams to unlock the potential of artificial intelligence.You will work closely with business leaders and operational teams across our international organization, making a tangible impact on the way we operate.Your Responsibilities- AI Portfolio Ownership: Consolidate AI initiatives, prioritize use cases, and coordinate their implementation across the Group.- Business Case Development: Identify AI opportunities in close collaboration with business units, define business value, and establish relevant KPIs.- Operational Process Optimization: Work closely with the relevant departments to optimize operational processes, including route planning, dispatching, customer service, capacity management, and data-intensive workflows through the application of AI.- Scaling AI Solutions: Support pilot projects, standardize successful applications, and drive their implementation and rollout across the Group.- Organizational Enablement: Engage and empower employees and managers on AI-related topics through workshops, training sessions, and the sharing of best practices.- Governance & Stakeholder Management: Ensure the responsible use of AI and provide regular reports to Group management on progress, business value, and associated risks.Your Profile- A university degree, e.g. in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, Technology/Innovation Management, or a comparable qualification.- Relevant professional experience - ideally 3-5 years - in business transformation, digitalization, process optimization, change management, operational excellence, technology implementation, or management consulting.- Proven experience in successfully implementing complex, cross-functional transformation or digitalization programs within a decentralized or international organization.- A very good understanding of business processes, operational workflows, and business cases.- Hands-on experience with generative AI and automation tools, as well as a solid understanding of how modern AI concepts and AI agents can be applied - without necessarily being a software developer.- Experience in designing and facilitating workshops, training sessions, and stakeholder meetings, combined with strong communication and influencing skills at all levels, including senior management.- A basic understanding of AI governance, data protection, and information security.- Excellent English language skills and a willingness to travel occasionally to our Group companies for workshops, collaboration, and key meetings.What We Offer- Remote Work & Flexibility: Work 100% remotely from Germany, France, Belgium, or the Netherlands, with flexible working hours.- Responsibility & Impact: Drive our Group-wide AI transformation with a high degree of autonomy, short decision-making processes, and room for your own ideas.- Global Collaboration & Development: Work with international teams across our worldwide organization and benefit from structured onboarding and continuous learning opportunities.- Employee Benefits: Enjoy employee discounts, health and wellbeing initiatives, and additional benefits depending on your country of employment.Apply now and become part of our transformation journey!ContactTOI TOI & DIXI Group GmbHEUREF-Campus 140472 Düsseldorf

jobs.occupation: Packaging & Automation Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Verpackungstechnik)
jobs.description: Overview   At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.  We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you.  At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact.  Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. ‎About the opportunity At QIAGEN, we are committed to making improvements in life possible. As a Packaging Engineer, you will play a key role in developing, industrializing, and continuously improving packaging solutions across our Diagnostics and Life Sciences portfolio. As a subject matter expert for packaging technologies, you will provide technical guidance to R&D, Operations, Quality, Procurement, manufacturing partners, and suppliers, ensuring robust, scalable, compliant, and cost-effective solutions throughout the product lifecycle. Combining packaging development, supplier engineering, manufacturing implementation, and automation, you will contribute to new product introductions, drive packaging innovation, and support automation projects across our global manufacturing and supplier network. Your tasks include * Leading packaging development and industrialization for new and existing products, from concept and material selection through qualification and commercial implementation.* Driving packaging automation projects at QIAGEN and supplier sites, including equipment implementation, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ activities.* Providing technical packaging expertise to R&D, Operations, Quality, Procurement, manufacturing sites, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.* Optimizing packaging materials and processes for product protection, quality, sustainability, regulatory compliance, efficiency, and cost.* Driving continuous improvement, root cause investigations, standardization, and the evaluation and implementation of innovative packaging technologies. Your profile * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.* Several years of relevant experience in packaging engineering, packaging development, manufacturing engineering, supplier engineering, or industrialization.* Strong expertise in packaging materials, technologies, manufacturing processes, and transport requirements, ideally including ISTA and IATA.* Experience with automated packaging equipment and equipment implementation, including FAT/SAT and DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ, preferably within a GMP or similarly regulated environment.* Experience managing technical projects and collaborating with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional teams; experience in diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or life sciences is an advantage.* Knowledge of packaging qualification, risk management, FMEA, DoE, process capability, sustainability, and global manufacturing transfer is advantageous.* Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with fluent English; German is an advantage and occasional travel is expected.What we offer   * Bonus/Commission  * Local benefits   * Referral Program  * Volunteer Day  * Internal Academy (QIALearn)   * Employee Assistance Program   * Hybrid work (conditional to your role)  Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.    QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

jobs.occupation: Regional Collision Manager, Central (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description: What to ExpectTesla Regional Collision Managers lead our internal collision centres. You will be accountable for customer experience, people development, day-to-day operations and the growth of sites as our European customer base expands.This is a hands-on, multi-site leadership role. You will set standards for safety, quality and repair excellence, and build the next generation of collision leaders. We are looking for people who put the customer first, think from first principles, and have the judgement to grow a region — not simply to run one site.In this role you’ll be leading 3 sites across Germany, Austria and Belgium.What You’ll Do- Own results across customer experience, team performance, operations, strategy, and financials by consistently meeting monthly and quarterly targets.- Deliver a world-class customer experience by identifying trends, solving root causes, and building processes that make every repair faster, clearer, and more satisfying.- Lead and develop elite teams by coaching, mentoring, and growing top talent, setting the standard for communication, collaboration, and accountability.- Drive operational excellence by owning performance across multiple locations, championing safety, efficiency, quality, and continuous improvement.- Shape regional growth by defining strategy, evaluating market needs, and planning new site expansions with speed and precision.- Manage the business like a leader by optimizing quality, productivity, cost, revenue, and margin with a clear focus on long-term impact.What You’ll Bring- 10+ years of experience leading multi-unit collision centers, refurbishment centers, or similar operations- 5-10+ years of collision technical experience or aptitude preferred- Comfortable leading a dispersed team, setting priorities when demands compete, and running structured root-cause problem-solving.- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills — you connect with customers, teams, and partners with clarity and confidence.- Fluency with repair estimates and operational reporting; confident with standard digital tools.- Willingness to travel up to 75% or more if required within the region- High proficiency in English and German- Full, valid EU driving licenceTesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business.
